title: paeonia peregrina var. humilis
intro: Paeonia peregrina var. humilis, commonly known as Himalayan peony, is a plant species in the Paeoniaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate pain and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan peony are attributed to its ability to act as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan peony include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
